subject: RetailOps trial: readiness checklist & KPI alignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reddington <tom@retailops.com>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@retailops.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: RetailOps trial: readiness checklist & KPI alignment

Hi Tom / Aisha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the trial kickoff: 

1) Success criteria (what RetailOps will measure):
- Extraction precision: > 92% entity accuracy on sample invoices (10k rows)
- Latency: 95th pct < 450ms for single-request inference (30–50 token outputs)
- Throughput: sustain 5 QPS during peak ingestion window (2h/day)
- Integration: automated S3-to-Redwood ingestion and webhooks to your processing pipeline

2) Trial scope & assets needed from you by Fri Mar 25:
- Representative dataset (S3 URI or share link)
- List of evaluation prompts and edge cases (sheet or doc)
- Contact for infra (Aisha?) to approve access / firewall rules

3) Redwood deliverables by Wed Mar 30:
- Trial runbook (week-by-week checkpoints) + onboarding doc
- Baseline run and an initial quality report
- Short demo of the dashboard + routing/caching config we recommend

4) Owners & single-point contacts:
- RetailOps data: Aisha Malik (Aisha)
- Redwood trial lead: Karthik Iyer (me)
- Escalation / commercial: Marissa Cole
- Integration engineering support: Priyom Das

Attachments: I attached a one-page success criteria template and a skeleton runbook. Please review and flag anything missing.

Next steps: Can you confirm the dataset share + infra contact by EOD Fri (Mar 25)? If yes, we’ll schedule the kickoff for Tue Mar 29 (30 minute alignment + account access).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: retailops_trial_success_criteria.xlsx (xlsx), retailops_runbook_snapshot.pdf (pdf)

From: Tom Reddington <tom@retailops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@retailops.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailOps trial: readiness checklist & KPI alignment

Thanks Karthik — solid recap. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Dataset: will share an S3 URI by EOD Thu (Mar 24) — contains ~12k invoice records.
- Infra: Aisha will be the primary infra contact; she’s looping in our cloud security lead if any VPC peering / allowlists are required.
- KPIs: latency target is realistic; on throughput we may need to start at 2–3 QPS and run a ramp to 5 QPS across week 2. Can Redwood provide a recommended ramp schedule in the runbook?

Also one ask: can Redwood run an initial dry-run on a 1k sample in our staging bucket before we open full dataset access? That would help unblock security approvals.

—
Tom
VP Product — RetailOps
Tom@retailops.com

Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailOps trial: readiness checklist & KPI alignment

Tom — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. Couple of notes and commitments: 

- Dry-run: yes — we can run a dry-run on a 1k sample in your staging bucket. Priyom will coordinate access and schedule it for Fri Mar 26 morning.
- Ramp schedule: included in the attached runbook draft — week 1: baseline (1–2 QPS), week 2: ramp to 3–4 QPS, week 3: reach 5 QPS with sustained checks. We’ll include monitoring thresholds and automatic fallback rules.
- Access: Aisha, when you have the S3 path + permissions, reply-all with the object URI and an AWS role we can assume (or pre-signed links). If there are any IP allowlist requirements, circle those in your response and we’ll get infra to expedite.

I attached a populated success-criteria sheet with the metrics we discussed and a draft runbook. Please review and comment inline. If that looks good, can we lock in Tue Mar 29 10:00 AM PT for a 30-minute kickoff? I’ll send a calendar invite pending confirmation.

Thanks —
Karthik

Attachment stubs: retailops_trial_success_criteria.xlsx (xlsx), retailops_runbook_snapshot.pdf (pdf)

Quick update from infra side: 

- I’ve scheduled the dry-run for Fri Mar 26 at 9:30 AM PT. We’ll pull a 1k sample from the staging bucket and run the baseline model on Redwood-Dedicated-1.
- Tom / Aisha: please confirm the staging S3 URI and a role we can assume (or a pre-signed link). If we don’t have the link by EOD today, we’ll move the run to Mon Mar 29 morning — still OK for the timeline but would push the formal kickoff to Wed.
- I attached a short checklist of what we verify during the dry-run and the initial monitoring thresholds.

I’ll send the run results and the baseline report by end of day Fri after the run completes.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Integration Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
